description:
Traffic in a street of Calapan city, Philippines. 
I made this recording near a downtown street of Calapan city (Oriental Mindoro, Philippines), One can hear quite heavy traffic with lots of vehicles (cars, motorcycles, some trucks and some jeepneys) passing by and onking at times, as well as the voices of some people in the street. 
Recorded in July 2025 with a Zoom H5studio (built-in XY microphones). 
Fade in/out applied in Audacity.
name: 250729_093315_PH_Traffic_in_a_street_of_Calapan
